briefings.tldr: Under the leadership of President and Head of AI Michele Catasta, Replit pivoted from a cloud-based IDE to an AI-agent-first platform, scaling from $2.5 million to a projected $1 billion ARR by empowering "vibe coders" to build and deploy applications via natural language.
